preference.reason: Close call; mean rubric scores are equal (8.18 each). X is the better teaching text (numeric Δ example, recipe-confound analysis, fewer seams in the LM section). Y is factually clean (0 wrong in 28 claims) and carries more verified evidence (induction-heads table, full SC09 table, U-Net ablation table, audio Mamba-S4 ablation, and the complex-parameterization caveat that X announces but never states).
